## TASK-033 - Implement the inactive macOS host adapter

Deliver explicit install/status/uninstall/relocation operations for a per-checkout host adapter while preserving existing hooks and the Template watcher.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |
| Skip authority | None |
| Requirements | REQ-016, REQ-022, REQ-038 |
| Design basis | None |
| Target artifacts | SKILLS-depo/curate/scripts/curator_host_macos.py, CURATION-depo/adapters/macos.md |
| Dependencies | TASK-021, TASK-032 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- A loaded launch agent is not proof of readiness; persistent real-project installation remains excluded.

### Acceptance criteria

- Status distinguishes idle/pending/unavailable/blocked/ready with fresh runtime checks.
- Relocation revalidates identity; detached external volumes retain pending state and cannot trigger deletion.
- Distribution installs no service or hook.

### Planned verification

- Inspect generated host assets and use separately authorized disposable foreground/temporary-host checks.
- Exercise unavailable volume, stale process/readiness, relocation and exact-operation uninstall/recovery.

### Risks

- A terminal Curator result does not automatically validate original-work prerequisites.

### Acceptance criteria

- Original work remains recoverable without a competing execution or fabricated consent.
- Completion/blocked maintenance returns to a fresh relevant integrity/scope/assumption check; remaining blockers prevent dependent continuation.

### Planned verification

- Test successful and blocked maintenance, changed assumptions, lost authority and original-work continuation.
